notes.title: v1.1.0 Released
notes.content:
Hello psychonauts!

I'm excited to announce soundStrider's first minor update. Since release I've received several suggestions to help improve its accessibility. This update adds an audio glossary that explains its audio cues, settings to adjust the visualizer, and over a dozen new color schemes to choose from.

Here are the full patch notes:
[list][*][b]Added Audio Glossary screen[/b][list][*]Added button to access the Audio Glossary screen[/*][*]Added audio previews for various cues[/*][*]Added spoiler-free descriptions for various cues[/*][/list][/*]
[*][b]Added Visualizer Settings screen[/b][list][*]Added button to access the Visualizer Settings screen[/*][*]Added color scheme selector with various presets[/*][*]Added sliders for brightness, contrast, hue, and saturation[/*][*]Added slider for adjusting visualizer sensitivity[/*][*]Added toggle for inverting visualizer colors[/*][*]Hidden when graphics are disabled via Performance Settings screen[/*][/list][/*]
[*][b]Added color schemes[/b][list][*]Achromatic (included in demo)[/*][*]Cherry Blossom[/*][*]Deciduous[/*][*]Desert[/*][*]Ink[/*][*]Light[/*][*]Magma[/*][*]Monochromatic (included in demo)[/*][*]Pastel[/*][*]Plasma[/*][*]Rainbow (included in demo)[/*][*]Sky[/*][*]Sunburst[/*][*]Water[/*][/list][/*]
[*][b]Miscellaneous[/b][list][*]Added Add Star toggle to Save Bookmark screen[/*][*]Fixed delayed triggering of tempo-synced props on load[/*][*]Fixed oscillator type of breadcrumb directional cues[/*][*]Improved clarity of toggle button labels[/*][*]Improved instrument preset spawning[/*][*]Improved performance of visualizer[/*][*]Updated manual to reflect changes[/*][*]Animations may differ slightly with this release[/*][/list][/*][/list]
Cheers!

notes.title: Coming July 10
notes.content:
Hello psychonauts!

I'm excited to announce that soundStrider will be released on July 10! Since launching the demo on Steam earlier this year it has received numerous updates based on player feedback like an audio mixer, mouse sensitivity and performance settings, and an accessible [url=https://soundstrider.shiftbacktick.io/manual.html]online manual[/url].

To celebrate, please enjoy a poisonous trailer:

[previewyoutube=WxExTdjoIMo;full][/previewyoutube]
Upgrading from the demo unlocks a variety of new features:
[list][*]Twelve additional environments like cities, space, and underwater
[*]A poison system that affects both audio and visual cues
[*]A virtual instrument with two dozen collectible preset sounds
[/list]
Thank you to all playtesters and early access players for your feedback and support.

Cheers!

notes.title: Beta 6 released
notes.content:
Hello psychonauts!

I hope you're enjoying the Steam Game Festival. After a productive week of working on soundStrider I'm looking forward to playing several of the demos.

The Beta 6 update adds a few new things for folks enjoying the demo:
[list][*]Improved bookmarks screens and flow
[*]Improvements to screen reader accessibility
[*]Virtual instrument with MIDI, keyboard, and gamepad controls
[*]Updates to the [url=https://soundstrider.shiftbacktick.io/manual.html]online game manual[/url]
[/list]
Demo players may notice that the notes they play on the virtual instrument are dead. Owners of the full game will be able to unlock and select from several presets as they play. Be sure to add soundStrider to your wishlist to experience its full potential.

Cheers!

notes.title: Introducing soundStrider
notes.content:
[h2]The game[/h2]
soundStrider is a psychedelic exploration game, walking simulator, music generator, and relaxation tool. Explore endless worlds and save bookmarks to revisit for meditation, studying, or sleep. All of its sounds are synthesized in real-time to evoke naturalistic, abstract, and musical spaces.

[h2]The demo[/h2]
Explore the beach, storms, pure oscillators, and more. Start an Adventure for a guided experience, or enter Free Roam to explore at your own pace.

This demo is a vertical slice of the soundStrider experience. The full game includes sixteen unique environment types, additional quests, and secrets to discover.

[h2]The developer[/h2]
I am shiftBacktick, the solo developer of soundStrider. I'm a web developer and accessibility advocate by trade with a background in computer music.

soundStrider began as a submission for Ludum Dare 45 as a short interactive audio experience. Since switching to full-time development six months ago it has evolved into an entirely new identity and scope. Every day is a delightful learning experience.

If you enjoy this demo, please consider adding soundStrider to your wishlist.

notes.title: Welcome to soundStrider
notes.content:
Hello psychonauts!

I'm pleased to announce that the soundStrider demo is live on Steam! I've been working on this game full-time for five months. In that time it's grown from its initial concept as an auditory exploration game into a psychedelic walking simulator filled with imaginative environments. All of its procedurally generated sounds are synthesized in real-time to evoke naturalistic, abstract, and musical spaces.

Its latest alpha update contains several changes for everyone playing the demo:
[list][*]Optimizations for all environmental sounds
[*]Improvements to world generation and object behavior
[*]Minor tweaks and fixes[/list]

Also included is a new breathing animation for its visualizer:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37436497/b8a3292e0f31264ab7817dbd87e3f3658f158544.gif[/img]


Progress on the game is advancing quickly. Over the next two months I plan to add over a dozen new sounds, more quests, and some secrets to discover. I'm looking forward to sharing more with you soon.

In the meantime, please enjoy the demo and add soundStrider to your wishlist.

Cheers!
